“I went through a very traumatic rupture of a tumultuous relationship. I am ashamed to say that this was not the first relationship I had to involve domestic violence and low self -esteem,” he wrote.
“In addition to the breakdown of my relationship, the launch of my failed album had cost me my savings and the relationship with the record label.”
Stating that he was on the verge of housing, he revealed that he was forced to move with his parents despite having supported them financially throughout his career.
“I was at his lowest point in my career, where my trust and finance were equally gloomy … I was in the rock bottom and I couldn’t see a path through him,” he wrote.
